verdict.rationale: Whether a customer data platform's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions open-source repositories or any license. The 'Client SDKs' item gives only a title, with no statement that the SDKs or the platform are openly licensed, so it cannot be credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
